description: Something a visitor sent from a published page's form. Deliberately generic: one entity serves a repair booking, an enquiry and a sign-up sheet alike, so a tenant never needs a schema of its own to collect an answer. `formName` says which form it came from and `data` holds the answers, which is what a workflow reads as ${event.data.<field>}.

formName.description: Which form on the site this came from, e.g. 'book-a-repair'

path.description: The page path the form was submitted from

data.description: The answers, as a flat object of field name to value

status.description: Where the tenant has got to with it -- 'new', 'handled'. Privileged: a visitor submits an answer, they do not get to say it has already been dealt with
